basis: The OPEN cycle inside donor-class-and-the-electorate.md's Washington PDC panel, pinned because the paper states its window as cycles 2016-2026 without noting that 2026 is a partial, still-filing cycle. Author decision 2026-08-25: disclose AND pin, matching how does-money-move-votes.md's open FEC cycle was handled the previous day. as_of is the panel's LATEST TRANSACTION DATE, not a download stamp -- the PDC layer is a static load, so the newest record it contains is what dates it, and 2026-05-19 is that record. Shares are of the whole loaded PDC layer (2,970,156 rows / $394.57M across cycles 2018-2030); 2026 is 2.12% of rows and 3.79% of dollars, so no headline in the paper turns on it. WHAT THIS PIN DOES NOT PROVE: that the PDC layer has not been reloaded since. It cannot -- there is no load-vintage column on individual_contributions. A reload that moved the 2026 slice would change these counts and the verifier would report it; that is the signal, and re-pinning is then a decision, not a refresh. Cycles beyond 2026 (2027-2030, 10,765 rows) are forward-dated filings and are outside the paper's stated window.
